```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
```

```{r Load packages}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(ineq)
library(emmeans)
library(multcomp)
library(tidyr)
library(DHARMa)
```

```{r Load data}
source("00_preprocess.R")
# TreeData and CanopyCover available with uppercase treatment names and Plot_number
```

```{r Treatment colors}
trt_colors <- c("M1" = "#D55E00", "M2" = "#E69F00",
                "2SP" = "darkseagreen2", "6SP" = "darkseagreen", "12SP" = "darkolivegreen")
```

```{r Summarize year 3}
CC3 <- CanopyCover %>% filter(Year == "3")

CC_plot <- CC3 %>%
  group_by(Site, Treatment, Plot_number) %>%
  summarise(
    Plot_CC = mean(Percent_canopy_cover, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD_CC = sd(Percent_canopy_cover, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

CC_avg <- CC_plot %>%
  group_by(Site, Treatment) %>%
  summarise(mean_cc = mean(Plot_CC), sd_cc = sd(Plot_CC), .groups = "drop")
```

```{r Model canopy cover year 3}
canopy_model <- lmer(Plot_CC ~ Treatment * Site + (1 | Site:Plot_number), data = CC_plot)

summary(canopy_model)
anova(canopy_model)

simulationOutput <- simulateResiduals(fittedModel = canopy_model, plot = TRUE)
testDispersion(simulationOutput)
testZeroInflation(simulationOutput)

cld_cc_site <- as.data.frame(cld(emmeans(canopy_model, ~ Treatment | Site),
  Letters = letters, adjust = "tukey", alpha = 0.05, decreasing = TRUE))

cld_cc_pooled <- as.data.frame(cld(emmeans(canopy_model, ~ Treatment),
  Letters = letters, adjust = "tukey", alpha = 0.05, decreasing = TRUE))
```

```{r Plot canopy cover — by site}
canopybar <- ggplot(CC_avg, aes(x = Treatment, y = mean_cc, fill = Treatment)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  geom_jitter(data = CC_plot, aes(y = Plot_CC),
              width = 0.2, size = 1.5, alpha = 0.5, color = "black") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = pmax(mean_cc - sd_cc, 0), ymax = mean_cc + sd_cc),
                width = 0.2, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_text(data = cld_cc_site, aes(y = Inf, label = .group),
            vjust = 1, size = 3, family = "sans") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = trt_colors, guide = "none") +
  facet_wrap(~ Site) +
  labs(x = "Treatment", y = "Mean Canopy Cover (%)") +
  theme_classic()

ggsave("canopy_barplot_year_3.jpeg", plot = canopybar, width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```

```{r Plot canopy cover — pooled}
CC_avg_pooled <- CC3 %>%
  group_by(Treatment) %>%

CC_plot_pooled <- CC3 %>%
  group_by(Treatment, Plot_number) %>%

canopybar_pooled <- ggplot(CC_avg_pooled, aes(x = Treatment, y = mean_cc, fill = Treatment)) +

ggsave("canopyyear3_pooled.jpeg", plot = canopybar_pooled, width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```

```{r Gini canopy cover — model and plot}
gini_cc <- CC3 %>%
  group_by(Site, Treatment, Plot_number) %>%
  summarize(Gini_CC = ineq(Percent_canopy_cover, type = "Gini"), .groups = "drop")

gini_cc_avg <- gini_cc %>%
  group_by(Site, Treatment) %>%
  summarize(mean_gini = mean(Gini_CC), sd_gini = sd(Gini_CC), .groups = "drop")

gini_model_cc <- lmer(Gini_CC ~ Treatment * Site + (1 | Site:Plot_number), data = gini_cc)

summary(gini_model_cc)
anova(gini_model_cc)

simulationOutput <- simulateResiduals(fittedModel = gini_model_cc, plot = TRUE)
testDispersion(simulationOutput)
testZeroInflation(simulationOutput)

cld_gini_cc <- as.data.frame(cld(emmeans(gini_model_cc, ~ Treatment | Site),
  Letters = letters, adjust = "tukey", alpha = 0.05, decreasing = TRUE))

ginibar <- ggplot(gini_cc_avg, aes(x = Treatment, y = mean_gini, fill = Treatment)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  geom_jitter(data = gini_cc, aes(y = Gini_CC),
              width = 0.2, size = 1.5, alpha = 0.5, color = "black") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = pmax(mean_gini - sd_gini, 0), ymax = mean_gini + sd_gini),
                width = 0.2, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_text(data = cld_gini_cc, aes(y = Inf, label = .group),
            vjust = 1, size = 3, family = "sans") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = trt_colors, guide = "none") +
  facet_wrap(~ Site) +
  labs(x = "Treatment", y = "Mean Gini Coefficient of Canopy Cover") +
  theme_classic()

ggsave("ginicanopyyear3.jpeg", plot = ginibar, width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```

```{r Time series — canopy cover}
CC_LLFS <- CanopyCover %>%
  filter(Site == "LLFS") %>%
  mutate(Year_label = case_when(
    Year == "2" ~ "Year 2",
    Year == "3" ~ "Year 3",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  ))

CC_other <- CanopyCover %>%
  filter(Site != "LLFS") %>%
  mutate(Year_label = case_when(
    Year == "1" ~ "Year 1",
    Year == "2" ~ "Year 2",
    Year == "3" ~ "Year 3",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  ))

CC_time <- bind_rows(CC_LLFS, CC_other) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Year_label)) %>%
  mutate(Year_label = factor(Year_label, levels = c("Year 1", "Year 2", "Year 3")))

CC_time_summary <- CC_time %>%
  group_by(Site, Treatment, Plot_number, Year_label) %>%
  summarise(Plot_CC = mean(Percent_canopy_cover, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

canopy_time_model <- lmer(Plot_CC ~ Treatment * Site * Year_label + (1 | Site:Plot_number),
                           data = CC_time_summary)
anova(canopy_time_model)

CC_time_avg <- CC_time_summary %>%
  group_by(Site, Treatment, Year_label) %>%
  summarize(Plot_CC = mean(Plot_CC), SD_CC = sd(Plot_CC), .groups = "drop")

trt_labels <- c("12SP" = "12-species plots", "2SP" = "2-species plots",
                "6SP" = "6-species plots", "M1" = "N-fixer monocultures (1)",
                "M2" = "Fleshy fruit monocultures (2)", "C" = "Control")

for (site in c("FAB", "FCEA", "LLFS")) {
  d <- CC_time_avg %>% filter(Site == site)

  show_legend <- site == "LLFS"
  p <- ggplot(d, aes(x = Year_label, y = Plot_CC, group = Treatment, color = Treatment)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) + geom_point(size = 5) +
    scale_color_manual(values = trt_colors, labels = trt_labels) +
    ylim(0, 100) +
    labs(x = "Years after Planting", y = "Mean Canopy Cover (%)", color = "Treatment") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 11), axis.title = element_text(size = 12))

  if (!show_legend) p <- p + theme(legend.position = "none")
  w <- if (show_legend) 6 else 4
  ggsave(paste0("canopy_", site, ".jpeg"), plot = p, width = w, height = 5, dpi = 300)
}
```
